answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 236 Country: United Kingdom Title: What are the conditions of being a witness at a Nikah and what is the ruling if the girl does not have any close relatives who can be the witnesses? Question: What are the conditions of being a witness at a Nikah and what is the ruling if the girl does not have any close relatives who can be the witnesses? Answer ID: 236 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 403/B) The witness can be anyone who is aaqil (sane), baaligh (adult) and Muslim. It is not necessary for a witness to be from immediate relatives. However, there should be two witnesses who can listen and understand the Nikah words that are exchanged by a man and woman: ولاینعقد نکاح المسلمین الا بحضور شاھدین حرین عاقلین بالغین الخ (ھدایہ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
